title: Grateful Dead Live at Mammoth Gardens on 1970-04-24

ai_review.summary: Mediocre recording of an incomplete Denver Fillmore show – historically interesting but not a great listening experience.
ai_review.review: The tape captures only part of the April‑1970 Denver performance at the Fillmore on Colfax and suffers from sub‑par sound quality. Reviewers note that it isn’t a complete or especially good recording, though they appreciate its place in local Dead history.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one brief review (3‑star) mentions poor recording quality and an incomplete show, with no strong praise for performance; rating reflects modest musical value offset by technical shortcomings.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Not a great recording; incomplete capture of the concert, likely missing sections and lacking clarity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No comments on set structure; review only notes that the show is incomplete.
